revision_note: Revised before any tool run (no fixture had been built or executed): three fixtures' move commits are diffed by git as a small deletion (the moved block is matched, so the deleted side is the 1-line heading or the 6-line head, below --threshold=20) and therefore raise no event; only the drop commit is an event. Predictions keyed to the drop commit only.
method: predictions derived by hand from the v4 definitions in the tool docstring/body (sections() at tools/append-only-audit.py:265, origins() at :423, the carve-out gate at :475, file_regions() at :384, vanished() at :291, the `not files` skip at :437) before building or running any fixture; `predicted` is what those definitions compute, `intended` is what the v4 purpose stated in the docstring (:1-40) implies for the same fixture

scenarios.axis: heading inside a fenced code block whose lines move

contract_rows: SCORE.md	A-corr	NOTES.md:1	exempt=## Axes@NOTES.md:2	fixture
fixture.c1: SCORE.md: [# score, ## Axes, h0..h4, ## Round 1, d0..d4, ```, ## Axes, f0..f24, ```]  (the fenced body f0..f24 sits under a quoted `## Axes` inside the fence, in the dated part of the file)
fixture.c2: f0..f24 moved out of the fence into the real ## Axes head; the fence keeps only its quoted heading (diff: 9 deletions, below threshold, no event)
fixture.c3: f0..f24 dropped from the head and replaced by 30 regrow lines g0..g29 (diff: 25 deletions)

intended.reason: the 25 lines are dated-section text (they sit under ## Round 1); a fenced ## Axes is a quotation, not a heading, and must not make a home for them in the exemption

scenarios.why: sections() (:265) is fence-blind: any line starting with b'## ' becomes a title, so the quoted heading inside the fence gives the fenced body the exempt title; origins() (:423) reuses sections(), so origin(f_i) = {'## Axes'} and the :475 gate passes

scenarios.axis: CRLF line text born in a dated section moved into the head (byte-exact move)

contract_rows: SCORE.md	A-corr	NOTES.md:1	exempt=## Axes@NOTES.md:2	fixture
fixture.c1:
SCORE.md (mixed endings): [# score
, ## Axes
, h0..h4
, ## Round 1
, 25 lines d0..d24 each ending 
]
fixture.c2: the 25 CRLF lines moved byte-exact into the ## Axes head (still \r\n; diff: 1 deletion, no event)
fixture.c3: the 25 CRLF lines dropped from the head and replaced by 30 LF regrow lines (diff: 25 deletions)

intended.reason: text born in ## Round 1 keeps that origin through a byte-exact move, so the drop under ## Axes is graded

scenarios.why: the \r survives split_lines() (:300) unchanged, so the deleted bytes equal the born bytes and origin(l) = {'## Round 1'}

scenarios.axis: CRLF dated text moved into the head with CRLF->LF normalisation in the move commit

contract_rows: SCORE.md	A-corr	NOTES.md:1	exempt=## Axes@NOTES.md:2	fixture
fixture.c2: the 25 dated lines moved into the ## Axes head and normalised to LF in the same commit (diff: 25 deletions of the \r\n bytes, 25 additions of the LF bytes)
fixture.c3: the 25 LF lines dropped from the head and replaced by 30 LF regrow lines (diff: 25 deletions)

intended.reason: a line-ending normalisation does not change the words: the dated birth should survive it and the drop under ## Axes should be graded

scenarios.why: the LF variant is a new byte string first held at c2, inside ## Axes, so origin(LF text) = {'## Axes'} and the :475 gate ungrades the c3 drop; the exit code is still 1 but from c2 reading the merely-normalised text as an unrestored 25-line loss, not from the drop

scenarios.axis: the same normalising move split below the 20-line event threshold

contract_rows: SCORE.md	A-corr	NOTES.md:1	exempt=## Axes@NOTES.md:2	fixture
fixture.c2: 13 of the 25 dated lines moved into the head and normalised to LF (13 deletions < threshold, no event)
fixture.c3: the remaining 12 moved and normalised (12 deletions < threshold, no event)
fixture.c4: all 25 LF lines dropped from the head and replaced by 30 LF regrow lines (diff: 25 deletions)

intended.reason: 25 dated lines are gone; the absence of a graded event for the normalisation is not a licence

scenarios.why: no normalising move reaches --threshold, and by c4 every dropped line's first appearance is inside ## Axes: origin = {'## Axes'}, the :475 gate passes, exit 0

scenarios.axis: a preamble (no section) line moved into the head and dropped

contract_rows: SCORE.md	A-corr	NOTES.md:1	exempt=## Axes@NOTES.md:2	fixture
fixture.c1: SCORE.md: [# score, 25 preamble lines p0..p24 (before the first ## heading), ## Axes, h0..h4, ## Round 1, d0..d2]
fixture.c2: the 25 preamble lines moved into the ## Axes head (diff: 6 deletions, no event)
fixture.c3: the 25 lines dropped from the head and replaced by 30 regrow lines (diff: 25 deletions)

intended.reason: None is not an exempt title, so preamble-born text stays graded wherever it is later deleted

scenarios.why: origin(l) = {None} for preamble-born text; frozenset({None}) & titles is empty at :475

scenarios.axis: two contract rows matching one file with different exempt titles

contract_rows: SCORE.md	A-corr	NOTES.md:1	exempt=## Axes@NOTES.md:3	row A
SCORE.md	A-corr	NOTES.md:1	exempt=## Planned@NOTES.md:3	row B
fixture.c1: SCORE.md: [# score, ## Axes, h0..h4, ## Planned, q0..q24]
fixture.c2: the 25 ## Planned lines moved into the ## Axes head (diff: 1 deletion, no event)
fixture.c3: the 25 lines dropped from the head and replaced by 30 regrow lines (diff: 25 deletions)

intended.reason: both titles are declared re-derived in place, so text born in either one is exempt text; the union is what the contract says

scenarios.why: file_regions() (:384) unions the two rows' titles; origin(q_i) = {'## Planned'} intersects the union at :475

scenarios.axis: two rows for one file: one whole-file (*) and one exempt, both valid

contract_rows: SCORE.md	A-corr	NOTES.md:1	exempt=## Axes@NOTES.md:2	exempt row
fixture.c1: SCORE.md: [# score, ## Axes, 25 o lines, ## Round 1, d0..d2]
fixture.c2: the 25 ## Axes lines rewritten in place (diff: 25 deletions)

intended.reason: a row declaring `*` grades every line of the file; a second row cannot loosen a rule the contract states without qualification, so the stricter row should win (or the contract should reject the disagreement)

scenarios.why: file_regions() (:384) ignores the `*` row entirely (it collects only exempt titles and only prefixes), so the exempt row alone decides and the carve-out applies

scenarios.axis: a file renamed (--no-renames diff): declared file renamed to an undeclared path

contract_rows: SCORE.md	A-corr	NOTES.md:1	exempt=## Axes@NOTES.md:2	fixture
fixture.c1: SCORE.md: [# score, ## Axes, a0..a24, ## Round 1, d0..d24] (52 lines) plus NOTES.md
fixture.c2: git mv SCORE.md OTHER.md, no content change

intended.reason: the loss is caught (exit 1) but only as a vanished path; no deleted count is attached to it

scenarios.why: files = expand(patterns, tip) is empty (SCORE.md is not at the tip) and audit() skips every commit when `not files` (:437), so the 52-line deletion raises no event; vanished() (:291) reads the --no-renames log, sees SCORE.md and reports it

scenarios.axis: a declared file renamed to another path the same wildcard row covers

fixture.c2: git mv corpus/lessons/r1.md corpus/lessons/r2.md, no content change

intended.reason: the old path leaves the declared set, so the 30-line deletion is a loss; caught, but with no deleted count

scenarios.why: files at tip = [corpus/lessons/r2.md]; numstat is asked only about r2.md (additions only), so the old path's 30 deletions never reach deleted_lines(); vanished reports r1.md

scenarios.axis: an undeclared file renamed onto a declared path

contract_rows: SCORE.md	A-corr	NOTES.md:1	exempt=## Axes@NOTES.md:2	fixture
fixture.c1: DRAFT.md: [# draft, ## Axes, 25 lines] (26 lines); no SCORE.md
fixture.c2: git mv DRAFT.md SCORE.md, no content change

intended.reason: arriving at a declared path is an addition; the file is audited from the first commit that holds it

scenarios.why: SCORE.md's diff against c1 is 26 additions and 0 deletions; DRAFT.md is not matched by any pattern so it is not vanished
